meta_description: Atari XL/XE lives on. Play Dynakillers, International Karate, Archon, The Goonies, River Raid, H.E.R.O., Boulder Dash and Karateka right in your browser.
og_title: ATARI800 — Eight bits. Still the same joy.
og_description: Atari XL/XE classics in a new web arcade. Pick a game and play.
hero_description_first: Remember that feeling? Just one more game.
hero_description_second: Atari XL/XE classics, now ready to play right in your browser.
coming_first: The arcade grows one game at a time.
coming_second: There is already room for the next one.
empty: We do not have that game yet. Try another search.
about_first: We are returning to the games we loved on the Atari XL/XE. We are bringing their graphics, music and ideas to web versions you can play on a modern computer.
about_second: Bombs, well-timed punches, moves on Archon's board, or a treasure hunt with the Goonies? Pick a game or invite someone to share the keyboard. Then play one more.

dynakillers.description: Bombs, boulders and the last player standing. Blast your way to your rivals and watch out for your own explosions.

international-karate.description: Land the right punch. Dodge at the right moment. Enter the tournament with the original animations and Rob Hubbard's music, or challenge a second player.

archon.description: Strategy on the board, reflexes in the arena. Lead the forces of Light or Dark, cast spells and capture the five power points.

goonies.description: Two friends, eight challenges and a pirate treasure. One works the machinery while the other finds a way through. Goonies never say die.

river-raid.description: Stay on course, refuel in flight and blast through the next bridge. The original river, ships and helicopters in a classic that never lets up.

hero.description: A propeller pack, a laser and six sticks of dynamite. Fly through the original caves, blast obstacles and rescue the miner before your power runs out.

boulder-dash.description: Diamonds underfoot, boulders overhead. Dig through the original caves, outsmart the butterflies and find the exit before time runs out.

karateka.description: From the cliff to Akuma’s palace. Defeat the guards, escape the falling gate and rescue Mariko in a story with the original graphics and music.
